Although it’s more common in girls, boys and adults can also have scoliosis. Scoliosis is an abnormal curvature of the spine that occurs when the spine rotates and curves sideways at more than a 10-degree angle. From the back, you may appear to have poor posture or are leaning to one side. The condition happens gradually over time and usually develops before puberty. The medical staff at Victory Medical provides integrated care through both traditional and holistic methods.
How do you treat scoliosis?

When a physician at Victory Medical detects scoliosis, typically the care plan focuses on monitoring for changes rather than treatment. In some cases, however, your doctor may recommend a back brace to stop further changes in the curvature of your spine.

The medical staff at Victory Medical may recommend other treatments, such as surgery, on a case-by-case basis depending on factors such as the age and sex of the patient and severity and location of the curvature.
